import random,itertools,importlib.util,json,subprocess,sys,time
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('s','/workspace/submission/main.py');s=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(s)
def z_of(fac,m):
 z=0
 for st in itertools.product(range(3),repeat=m):
  w=1
  for vars,vals in fac:
   fi=0
   for v in vars: fi=fi*3+st[v]
   w*=vals[fi]
   if w==0: break
  z+=w
 return z
def find_order(edges,scopes):
 m=len(edges)
 # try min-degree heuristic plus random permutations bounded
 for trial in range(200):
  if trial==0:
   perm=None
  else:
   perm=list(range(m));random.shuffle(perm)
  adj=[set() for _ in edges]
  for sc in scopes:
   x=list(sc)
   for i in range(len(x)):
    for j in range(i+1,len(x)):
     adj[x[i]].add(x[j]);adj[x[j]].add(x[i])
  ok=True
  # if random choose min degree sequence from random tie; else min degree
  left=set(range(m)); seq=[]
  while left:
   if perm is None:
    x=min(left,key=lambda v:(len(adj[v]),v))
   else:
    # choose earliest in random perm among min-ish? use arbitrary restricted
    x=min(left,key=lambda v:(len(adj[v]),perm.index(v)))
   seq.append(x);left.remove(x)
   if len(adj[x])>4:ok=False;break
   ne=list(adj[x])
   for i in range(len(ne)):
    for j in range(i+1,len(ne)):
     adj[ne[i]].add(ne[j]);adj[ne[j]].add(ne[i])
   for y in ne:adj[y].discard(x)
   adj[x].clear()
  if ok:return [list(edges[x]) for x in seq]
 return None
random.seed(1001)
t0=time.time();found=0
for trial in range(200000):
 npaths=random.randint(2,10)
 cp={}
 # use structured labels to generate varied degrees
 for _ in range(npaths):
  L=random.randint(2,7)
  p=tuple(random.sample(range(1,10),L))
  cp[p]=cp.get(p,0)+random.randint(1,5)
 edges=sorted({s.canonical(a,b) for p in cp for a,b in zip(p,p[1:])})
 if not (1<=len(edges)<=6):continue
 ei={e:i for i,e in enumerate(edges)}
 sc,occ=s.build_scopes_and_occurrences(cp,ei)
 fac=s.make_factors(len(edges),sc,occ)
 if z_of(fac,len(edges))!=0:continue
 print('ZERO RAW trial',trial,'cp',cp,'edges',edges,'sc',sc)
 order=find_order(edges,sc)
 if order is None:
  print(' no order');continue
 print('FOUND',order)
 data={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':[{'path':list(p),'count':c} for p,c in cp.items()],'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':order,'queries':[{'id':'x','path':list(edges[0]),'threshold':[1,2]}]}
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(data).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
 print('OUT',r.stdout)
 found=1;break
 if time.time()-t0>110:break
print('done',trial,'found',found,'time',time.time()-t0)
